headline: The cup ring has gone dry.
body: The strip on the sill is a line now, not a band. Someone downstairs runs water, stops, then starts it again for the kettle. A bicycle ticks past without a bell.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pale and high, no weather in it

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: sill reduced to a line, desk in shade

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one bicycle, no bell, kettle below
